learning_outcomes.text: Acquiring the necessary infrastructure in creating policies, strategies and tactics regarding basic marketing components and learning how to use them in marketing practices.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts related to marketing: Marketing subject and scope, Development of marketing, Marketing understanding. Marketing environment: Marketing system and macro and micro environmental factors affecting marketing, Strategic planning, Marketing management process.
Marketing information system (PBS) and market research (PA): information need for marketing decisions, PBS and marketing, PA process and planning, main data collection methods in PA.

Final consumer markets and consumer behavior: Market and consumer types, Demographic and economic characteristics of consumer markets, Factors affecting consumer behavior, Consumer purchasing decision process. Industrial markets and industrial buyer behavior: Nature of industrial markets, their importance and types, structure and characteristics of the industrial market, industrial buyer behavior.
Market segmentation, target market selection and demand forecasts: Main market segmentation criteria, Target market selection strategies, Market evaluation and sales forecasts

1. Midterm exam, product: Product and related concepts as a decision variable, Classification, product planning, New product development, Product life cycle, Brand, Packaging, Service and quality strategies, Product differentiation, Fashion event.
Price and pricing: The importance of price as a decision variable, Pricing targets, Pricing methods in practice, New product pricing strategies, Price elasticity of demand.
Promotion: Promotion as a decision variable, Its importance and effects, Communication process and promotion functions, Main promotion methods.
Advertising and sales development: Purposes of advertising, Types, Selection of advertising media and advertising messages, Organization of the advertising department, Promotion and public relations.
Personal selling and sales management: The place and importance of personal selling in marketing, Sales tasks and types of salespeople, Stages of the sales process, Sales management.
2nd Midterm Exam, Distribution, distribution channels and physical distribution: Distribution channels, Selection of distribution channel, Major distribution policies, Physical distribution.

Organization and control in marketing management: The nature and importance of organization, The place of the marketing department in the business, Organization and control of the marketing department.

International marketing: Reasons for businesses to expand abroad and international marketing management, Environmental factors affecting international marketing, Types of entry into international markets.
Service marketing: Definition and types of services, Marketing concept in service businesses, Marketing strategies in service businesses.

Direct marketing and Internet marketing: Definition of direct marketing, Purposes, Benefits, Main types of direct marketing, Electronic commerce and Internet marketing, Characteristics of Internet users, Internet marketing strategies.
